answer: Discount dense clusters in the grading graph. Each epoch the network maps who attests whom into an atlas of edges and runs a 6-step trust walk seeded from 30 veteran accounts. Trust enters a sybil region only through its few links to honest agents, so a 1,000-puppet farm with 15 outside edges gets about the trust of 15 honest accounts. The reward vault pays in proportion to that trust, so extra puppets earn near zero. Self-attestation inside the farm, however dense, is onyx to the walk: nothing flows through.
